standard.summary: 设置参与 block offload 的比例，范围 0–100%，默认 100%。
standard.effect: 按比例选择 FLUX.3 Transformer blocks 参与 CPU/GPU 换入。
standard.whenToUse: 需要在显存占用与传输开销间取舍时调整。
standard.avoidWhen: 诊断性能时一次只改一个 offload 参数。

standard_en.summary: Percentage of blocks included in block offload, from 0 to 100. Default: 100%.
standard_en.effect: Selects the proportion of FLUX.3 Transformer blocks moved between CPU and GPU.
standard_en.whenToUse: Adjust when balancing VRAM use against transfer overhead.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Change only one offload setting at a time while diagnosing performance.
